workerLifecycleMatrix.method: fake Worker ports, deterministic timers, supplied legal fixture actions

actualThreadTests.method: Node worker_threads bridge to the actual compiled module entry; awaited native terminate promises and verified exit

browser.environment: cloud Chromium, HTTP static preview, actual module Workers, desktop-equivalent CSP
checks: full replay, E5 defense and single commit
pause during startup-to-search transition, stale task invalidation and resume
undo to AI waits for explicit continue
uncooperative CPU loop hard termination, main-thread response and explicit retry

commands: node --test --test-reporter=spec tests/ai.test.mjs tests/ai-matrix.test.mjs tests/ai-tactics.test.mjs tests/ai-tree.test.mjs tests/ai-search.test.mjs tests/session.test.mjs tests/restore-session.test.mjs tests/web.test.mjs tests/desktop.test.mjs

coveredBoundaries: separate macrotasks for consecutive A opening commands and B choosing white followed by B placing
duplicate start, sync, ready, reply and old captured callbacks
pause, undo, new game, load, direct cancelTask, resignation, terminal commit and close
failed undo and invalid load preserve the current task
late messages rejected even if watchdog callbacks are delayed
constructor, postMessage, message decoding, malformed and illegal action failures
observer exceptions, observer-triggered cancellation and factory reentrancy
terminate failure prevents accumulating replacement workers
real startup and compute infinite loops terminate physically while the main loop runs
limitsAndPending: Browser timers can be delayed by background throttling, suspension or a busy main thread; deadline checks still reject late replies.
Main-thread request export, structured clone and final rule validation remain synchronous; arbitrarily long records are not a zero-stall guarantee.
UI mutations must use change(); direct active-task mutations are monitored, and idle external mutations require sync().
The 1792 lifecycle cases use supplied actions, not 1792 live searches or complete matches.
The earlier full tactical and bounded-search matrices were not rerun; their reports remain historical evidence.
Actual qiline-scheme Electron Worker launch on Windows, mobile and Safari remain unverified.
Current deployed product remains PvP; human-vs-AI UI and a new Windows package belong to later stages.
